parole.significato: vat (a large tub, such as is used for making wine or for tanning)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Polish kadź, ultimately from Proto-Slavic *kȃdь, from Ancient Greek κάδιον (kádion), diminutive of κάδος (kádos).
